hypothesis: A 0.5-notional BTC long alongside each new-listing short may offset common crypto-market risk and improve funded net returns over the same short allocation.
execution: Freeze A05 short entry, horizon and risk contract. At 1x use total campaign budget for both legs, 2/3 short and 1/3 BTC long. SameShort removes the BTC leg with the same 2/3 per-slot and overall short allocation. FullShort is unmodified A05. Paired fills use the same next-bar close and per-side costs, subject to both volume caps. BTC quote capacity is shared by all overlapping positions; paired partial fills keep the inventory fractions equal. A stop on either leg requests both exits. Catastrophic barrier charges the affected isolated model collateral, with any surviving leg queued for the next bar. No netting credits. Both legs use actual settled funding at raw clocks while held, observed at the first five-minute boundary not earlier than the event. This is a bar model.
gate: At both costs across every listed window require positive net return greater than SameShort, <=40% observed drawdown lower than FullShort, no account halt or catastrophic collateral loss, and at least 30 closed campaigns in 12 weeks. The high-return hurdle is a 25% annualized stress return in at least two windows and beating FullShort in at least one window. All results are retrospective.
